## Changed
- Spotify and Deezer songs come only from YouTube Music now: the server searches the songs on YouTube Music (the album tracks, the same recordings as on Spotify) and never plain YouTube videos. Live, piano, karaoke and cover versions and other artists are left out, and of the rest the one with the same length as on Spotify wins
- If a song isn't on YouTube Music, the app says so and plays the next one instead of a random video
- Remembered matches are cleared again with this update, so every song is looked up fresh

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script / `musik-update`)
- **Android:** Settings → Updates, or install the new `Musik.apk` over the old one
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new `Musik.exe`
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates, or `chmod +x Musik.AppImage && ./Musik.AppImage`
